record.body:
## Rationale

The spikes already label noticed/not noticed and show surviving mutants. Productizing them against frozen claims meets the exit criteria without adopting an opaque mutator.

## Counter-argument

Hunk-revert alone is simpler. It would miss the surviving-mutant exit the phase body already names.

payload.alternatives: off-the-shelf mutator only; hunk-revert only and defer mutants
payload.choice: productize spikes/hunk-revert and capped mutants into advisory aff audit --base --head that judges with frozen claim tests via run_tests; never report test-file blocks

record.subject: audit-hunk-mutants
